description: Only for the Awning team. Every business on Awning with its status (live, waiting for approval, needs changes, not submitted, suspended), who runs it, and a link: the public page when live, the private preview otherwise. Filter by status or by part of the name. Use it to find a business by name, or to see every business in a state; for applications waiting for a decision use op_applications.

query.description: Part of the business name or its address on the site (slug)

status.description: Only businesses in this status: draft (not submitted), review (waiting for approval), published (live) or suspended

name: op_businesses
title: All businesses
